column1: # The package set, and the single source of truth for it.
# build/BuildNugets.sh packs in this order, the package tests read it. Adding a package means
# adding a row here and a project under src/ — nothing else keeps a second copy of the list.
#   id      the package's name segment: the .csproj/PackageId is Net.Agora.<id>.Mac
#   deps    other ids in this repository it depends on, comma separated, or -
# Only the products Agora distributes a native macOS SDK for are here: Video (RTC), Voice and
# Signaling (RTM), plus the RTC feature extensions. There is deliberately no Chat, IoT, Fastboard
# or Whiteboard row — Agora ships no native macOS SDK for those (netless's Whiteboard is a UIKit
# source pod with no AppKit build; its "macOS" offering is the JavaScript web SDK). See README.md.
# The optional RTC feature extensions: native payload only, no managed API, no dependency on
# either RTC package. Their frameworks come out of the AgoraRtcEngine_macOS archive itself — see
